editorialNote: Five stories — sold → forgotten → raised → revealed → resolved. Joseph's personal arc, strictly his POV: the pit, the prison, Pharaoh's court, the emptied hall, and the years-later forgiveness. Jacob-POV material from the same chapters is excluded the way daniel_arc excludes the Nebuchadnezzar arc. Story order ratified in slate_v2_beat_review.md.

stories.label: Genesis 37 — Joseph sold by his brothers (the coat, the pit, twenty pieces of silver)
stories.editorialNote: Canonical full-chapter telling; fully covered (six variants: Short/Full/Long x WEB/KJV). Its bibleStoryKey 'joseph_sold_by_brothers' is this journey's nameRegistryKey — registry entry + name clip are a before-ready gate, not yet present. 1197 (Gen 37:1-11, dreams-begin slice) and 1045 (kid-friendly legacy telling of the same anchor) excluded.

stories.label: Genesis 40 — but the cupbearer forgot him (two troubled dreams in an Egyptian prison)
stories.editorialNote: Only adult full-chapter Genesis 40 telling; fully covered (six variants). The forgotten-in-prison beat that makes the elevation land. 1389 (Gen 40:14-23, 'remember me' scene slice) excluded as redundant.

stories.label: Genesis 41 — Joseph interprets Pharaoh's dreams (from the dungeon to Pharaoh's court)
stories.editorialNote: 800-series story; fully covered (six variants). STANDING AUDIT NOTE (slate_v2 Open Items): full-length variants still need cross-checking against the 800-series content-audit per-variant decision queue before this journey flips ready — same open check as 825 in elijah_arc.

stories.label: Genesis 45 — Joseph reveals himself (the emptied hall, the weeping the Egyptians heard)
stories.editorialNote: The arc's hinge, hurting register. Fully covered (six variants).

stories.label: Genesis 50:15-21 — then Joseph wept ('you meant evil against me, but God meant it for good')
stories.editorialNote: The arc's resolution — the brothers' fear returning after Jacob's death, and Joseph's answer. COVERAGE-THIN: WEB Short only as of 2026-07-05 (NOT part of the 2026-07-04 KJV registration batch). A user on KJV or Full/Long gets the thin-fallback experience the learning_to_wait hold note describes; journey-driven-gap authoring candidate under the doctrine's exception.

_excludedFromArcWithRationale: 1325 (Genesis 47:7-10, 'Few and Evil Have Been My Years' — Jacob blesses Pharaoh) — Jacob-POV. Strong story but breaks Joseph's POV; the journey is Joseph's life, not his father's. Same rule as daniel_arc's Nebuchadnezzar exclusions.
1209 (Genesis 49:1-33, 'Listen to Israel Your Father' — Jacob blesses his sons) — Jacob-POV, same rule. Deathbed-blessing material belongs to a future Jacob or fathers-and-sons journey.
1197 (Genesis 37:1-11, 'The Coat of Many Colors' — the dreams begin) — scene slice of 1037's full chapter; redundant with the opener. Could be a Slice 3 alternate.
1389 (Genesis 40:14-23, 'Remember Me') — scene slice of 1178's chapter; redundant with beat 2. Could be a Slice 3 alternate.
1466 (Genesis 50:22-26, 'Joseph's Bones' — the deathbed oath) — epilogue past the arc's emotional endpoint; 1146 is the close. Candidate for a future promise-carried-through-Exodus thread.
1045 (kid-friendly legacy telling of joseph_sold_by_brothers) — kid-friendly variant, not an adult-lane candidate.
